caches.name: Dresser preview candidate snapshot
caches.invalidation: Replaced on the next visible idle preview cadence; refresh requests, station/page changes, configuration changes, and completed actions pull the deadline forward.

caches.name: Duplicate preview candidate snapshot
caches.invalidation: Replaced on the next visible duplicate-page idle cadence and after discard completion, cancellation, or stale-slot detection.

caches.name: Duplicate discard operation queue
caches.invalidation: Cleared on cancellation, terminal failure, completion, command replacement, and plugin unload; each active item has a 10-second native-operation deadline.

caches.name: Exportaramus ownership snapshot
caches.invalidation: At most 20000 sorted item IDs per each of seven collection sources; replaced on provider/session revision and cleared on character withdrawal.

caches.name: Diagnostic activity log
caches.invalidation: Oldest entries are trimmed immediately above capacity; explicit Clear and plugin unload remove the retained log.

caches.name: Remembered dresser and armoire station identities
caches.invalidation: Each of the two sets is capped at 256 identities and released with the controller on plugin unload.

caches.name: Duplicate review presentation
caches.invalidation: One All/Visible plan pair, rebuilt when either immutable input snapshot reference or ignored-ID membership changes; cleared on presentation withdrawal and disposal. Each pair contains at most 1024 inventory references and 800 Dresser references per plan. One copied ignored-ID set is bounded by the saved configuration count; no history is retained.

cachePolicy: Immutable provider snapshots and native-domain preview/operation collections are bounded. Visible previews refresh at most 2 Hz; restoration observes at most 4 Hz with a 15-second deadline. Duplicate queues reject more than 1024 physical candidates rather than truncating. The native Dresser queue is bounded by 800 entries. Character/provider withdrawal clears authority. Native live rendering and adapter cost still require in-game verification.
